correctness.rationale: Damped finite chain drift is Hurwitz: negative energy derivative at boundary and nonvanishing first coordinate of every tridiagonal Dirichlet normal mode preclude imaginary eigenvalues. Its L1 response kernels integrate to the affine static gains a_i=(n+1−i)/(n+1), b_i=i/(n+1). For a wall resetting at rate ελ, exponential stationary age A and conditional Brownian variance 2DA give √ε X a centered Laplace characteristic function 1/(1+Dt²/λ). At fixed lag the scaled difference of wall values goes to zero in L4, by Brownian increments off reset and Hölder/eighth-moment control on reset events; dominated convolution therefore yields joint L4 convergence to the two-independent-Laplace affine field. From independent Laplace cumulants, limiting covariance has rank 2 and the fourth-cumulant tensor factors as 12ηL² a⊗4+12ηR² b⊗4. Kurtosis is 3[p(u)²+(1−p(u))²] and uniquely minimal 3/2 at u=sqrtηL/(sqrtηL+sqrtηR). Stationary reset-Brownian and matched OU walls have exactly the same exponential lag covariance 2D/(ελ)e^(−ελ|t|), so linear chain x/v second-order covariances match at every ε, but OU outputs remain Gaussian. Independent static-gain, cumulant and variable-η kurtosis checks passed; the L4 limit is proved analytically, not by simulation.
residual_risks: Fixed finite n only, with independent resetting Brownian walls and damping; no interchange with n→∞ or finite-ε distribution is established.

value.rationale: The full low-reset spatial random field and rank-two non-Gaussian fourth-order signature are natural observables that distinguish reservoir mechanisms indistinguishable even with complete second-order space-time data. The exact spatial position of minimal kurtosis is mathematically motivated by harmonic interpolation rather than an arbitrary statistic.
residual_risks: The low-rate affine result may be implicit in general adiabatic linear-filter literature although not explicitly stated as a theorem in inspected same-model paper.

final_claim: For each fixed finite harmonic chain with two independent slowly resetting Brownian boundary walls, scaled stationary positions converge jointly in fourth moments to a rank-two affine field with independent Laplace amplitudes; exact kurtosis minimum and matched-OU second-order equivalence.
limitations: The fixed finite-n, ε→0 order of limits cannot be interchanged with n→∞ without new work.
Matched OU and resetting reservoirs agree in second order only, not in full law or dynamics.
